title: Authentication
description: users sign in with email and password; sessions expire; failed logins are limited.

title: User roles
description: roles agent, lead and admin control what a user may do.

title: Customer management
description: agents create, edit and deactivate customer records (name, email, phone, company).

title: Customer profile
description: a profile page shows customer data and the full history of the customer's tickets.

title: Ticket creation
description: agents create a ticket for a customer with title, description, category and priority.

title: Ticket assignment
description: leads and agents assign or reassign a ticket to a support agent.

title: Ticket status
description: tickets move through open, in progress, waiting for customer, resolved and closed.

title: Ticket priority
description: each ticket has a priority (low, medium, high, urgent) that can be changed.

title: Comments
description: agents add internal comments to a ticket; comments show author and time.

title: Search
description: agents search tickets and customers by keyword, ticket number or customer name.

title: Filtering
description: the ticket list can be filtered by status, priority, assignee and creation date.

title: Dashboard
description: a dashboard shows open tickets, tickets by status, tickets by priority and tickets per agent.

title: Basic reporting
description: leads export the filtered ticket list as CSV.

title: Agent management
description: leads and admins create, deactivate and edit support agent accounts.

title: Secure authentication
description: passwords hashed with a modern algorithm, tokens with expiry

title: Basic authorization
description: every API endpoint checks the caller's role

title: REST API
description: all functionality is exposed through a documented REST API returning JSON

title: Responsive web interface
description: usable on desktop and tablet screen sizes

title: PostgreSQL database
description: versioned schema migrations

title: Logging
description: structured application logs for requests and errors

title: Basic error handling
description: consistent error responses and friendly messages in the UI

title: Automated tests
description: unit and API tests for core flows, plus a small end-to-end smoke suite

title: Dockerized deployment
description: the whole stack starts with Docker Compose
